name: CaptureUiEnhanced
intent: A reality-capture progress workspace for a construction zone: a CanvasHeader (breadcrumb + week/capture selector + refresh & full-screen) over a three-pane body — a left rail (search, zone progress, a progress-distribution histogram, a villas-on-map list, and collapsible map-layer toggles), a center choropleth map of plot polygons + amenities with a floating view-mode switcher and an approved-progress legend, and a right detail rail for the selected villa (approved/planned/variance, milestones, progress-by-floor, evidence chain). Selecting a plot opens its detail; 'View blueprints' opens a per-floor sheet dialog.
when: Review a zone's approved-vs-planned construction progress on a choropleth site map
Drill a single villa/plot's milestones, per-floor progress, and reality-capture evidence
Toggle map layers (drone ortho, choropleth, roads, labels) over a weekly capture timeline
whenNot: Pan/zoom a single floor's blueprint plan -> use the BlueprintViewer template
A period-based WBS earned-value drill-down list -> use the ProgressDetails template
An org-level KPI overview across projects -> use a Dashboard/Overview template

chooseOver.component: Assembling CanvasHeader + a choropleth grid + a detail rail + Collapsible layer toggles by hand
chooseOver.because: This template owns the header/breadcrumb/week-selector composition, the shared progress-bucket colour ramp across the list/map/legend, the selected-plot detail rail, and the blueprints dialog flow.

regions.role: Top bar: breadcrumb (left) + built-in week/capture selector + refresh & full-screen actions (right)
regions.source: CanvasHeader widget (with its built-in WeekSelector) + Breadcrumb + Button

regions.role: Search + zone-progress card + progress-distribution histogram + villas-on-map list + collapsible map-layer toggles
regions.source: Input + Badge + Collapsible + Switch + local cards

regions.role: The real ROSHN Almanar site aerial ("Zone 1 - A") with the real villa footprint polygons coloured by construction progress, its own hover progress card, and a SPA/Construction legend
regions.source: SiteImageViewer widget (@wakecap/core-ui/site-image-viewer), fed the real footprints from @wakecap/core-ui/site-image-viewer-fixtures

regions.role: Selected-villa detail: approved/planned/variance stats, dual progress bars, milestones table, progress-by-floor bars, and an evidence-chain tab strip
regions.source: Collapsible + Tabs + Separator + Button + local stat cards
regions.note: Dismissable; hidden when no villa is selected / the rail is closed.

regions.role: Per-floor blueprint sheets for the selected villa (capture + date-range context)

requiredWidgets.name: CanvasHeader
requiredWidgets.note: Heads the canvas; carries the breadcrumb, the built-in WeekSelector, and the right-side actions.

requiredWidgets.name: SiteImageViewer
requiredWidgets.note: The real ROSHN Almanar aerial + villa footprint overlay with its own hover progress card and SPA/Construction legend; the template feeds it the fixtures' villas + image size.

optionalWidgets.name: WeekSelector
optionalWidgets.note: Composed inside CanvasHeader via its weekSelector prop; drives the weekly capture timeline.

requiredComponents.name: Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.note: Project -> zone path in the header left cluster.

requiredComponents.name: Button
requiredComponents.note: Refresh / full-screen, close-detail, view-blueprints, and dialog actions.

requiredComponents.name: Collapsible
requiredComponents.note: Map-layer toggles, milestones, and progress-by-floor sections.

requiredComponents.name: Tabs
requiredComponents.note: View-mode switcher, legend SPA/Construction, and the evidence-chain strip.

dataContract.note: Self-contained demo: villas, amenities, milestones, floors, layers and the weekly captures are module-level mock data. Selection, layer toggles, the selected capture, and the blueprints dialog are local state. No props; render as-is and replace the mock constants with real data when wiring.

states.default: Villa 2083 TH1-L selected; the detail rail is open and capture 122 (Sep 5-11) is active.
states.plot-selected: Clicking a plot in the list or on the map selects it and (re)opens the detail rail.
states.search-empty: A query with no matches shows an empty-state message in the villas-on-map list.
states.layers-toggled: Switching a map layer off drops its choropleth fill / labels on the plot polygons.
states.blueprints-open: 'View blueprints' opens the per-floor sheet Dialog for the selected villa.
states.detail-closed: Closing the detail rail collapses the third pane; the map takes the full width.

responsive.strategy: Fixed three-pane workspace: a 340px left rail, a fluid center map, and a 400px detail rail, inside a full-height column under the CanvasHeader.

breakpoints.lg: The header's 'Updated N min ago' hint is hidden below lg to keep the right cluster compact.

allowedPlacement: route-level workspace (full screen, inside the app shell content region)
forbiddenPlacement: inside a narrow sidebar/panel (needs the full three-pane width)

commonMistakes.symptom: TypeScript error — the component takes no props
commonMistakes.fix: Replace the module-level mock constants (VILLAS, AMENITIES, MILESTONES, FLOORS, CAPTURES) with real data, or lift them to props when generalising.

commonMistakes.symptom: The list dot, the map fill, and the legend ramp drift apart
commonMistakes.fix: The map colours come from SiteImageViewer's milestone ramp; keep the left-rail list dots + distribution on the same bucket thresholds so they read together.

commonMistakes.symptom: A bespoke <header> instead of the canvas bar
commonMistakes.fix: Use the CanvasHeader widget with left (Breadcrumb), weekSelector, and right slots.

evaluationCriteria.check: Chosen for a zone reality-capture progress map — not BlueprintViewer (single floor plan) or ProgressDetails (WBS list).
Renders the CanvasHeader, the left rail, the choropleth map, and the villa detail rail.
Selecting a plot updates the detail rail; toggling a layer changes the map; 'View blueprints' opens the dialog.
Produces the three-pane reality-capture workspace under a CanvasHeader.
